g.text: Program size during search | Current-generation champion
Node count of each generation's best program | Not population-average size | Raw per-generation values
ASGP and GAGP count nodes in different representations; absolute sizes are not interchangeable. Track growth within each mode.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: The archived GAGP binary does not record per-generation population mean size. Final population mean size and peak RSS are in runs.csv.
